annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council)
key_provisions_or_claims: Four-level national emergency response (I–IV) with quantified triggers such as road, rail, airport disruption, power and communications outages
Defines roles of the National Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief Commission and member ministries
Colour-coded four-level meteorological early warning system
Information reporting and release rules, including twice-daily reporting at levels I–II
Mentions R&D of drone inspection and de-icing equipment under technology support
annotation.summary_en: China's State Council General Office circular issuing the National Emergency Plan for Low-Temperature, Rain, Snow and Freezing Disasters. It sets the organisational system, monitoring and warning, four-level emergency response with triggers, and support measures. It has no AI or robotics content beyond a passing mention of drone inspection R&D.
